description: S458 slice 2 (position 2): a refined STRUCT FIELD is judged where a struct value is written. The literal `{ href: "https://scrml.dev/", weight: -1 }` assigned to `Link` has `weight: -1` against `number(>0)`: E-CONTRACT-001. Before S458 only an enum-subset field was checked this way; a `number(...)` / `string(...)` field was never judged.
rationale: §53.2.2 lists "struct field: type Invoice:struct = { amount: number(>0 && <10000) }" as a usage position; §53.15.2's static row decides a literal field at compile time; §53.11 E-CONTRACT-001.
